verdict.rationale: The Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop processor, so driving it through a documented public API, in the sense of a service or app endpoint for agents, is a category error for this kind of product. The oneAPI, OpenVINO and DirectML mentions are developer frameworks for running workloads on the hardware, not an API for operating the product. The OpenAPI probe failures on intel.com say nothing about a CPU's capabilities.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
